## Hosted refusal and exact corpus evidence

At main `8d06644a481071ed4566373660bfa0d3772c38c9`, the [2026-10-28 gated-sync job](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-review/actions/runs/40646598672/job/122676744472) fails during **Preview GitHub to pm plan**, before the import or publication steps.

The reusable workflow is `pm-github/.github/workflows/pm-github-sync.yml@d772360c1a099b968908f86026c1cb53c1a499f8`. Its resolved package is **pm-github 2026.10.23**; the deprecated input says 2026.10.16 but is not the installed-version receipt.

The attempted read-only command is:

```text
pm github import unbraind/pm-review --state all --atomic --gate --dry-run --with-comments
```

At 06:53:34 UTC it reports:

```text
pm github gate: import plan is not idempotent — 1 duplicate provenance tag(s) in the existing corpus, 0 new entr(y/ies) without a provenance tag, 0 conflicting target(s). No item was written.
```

Independent static inspection of all 59 canonical tracker records at this immutable revision finds exactly one repeated top-level `gh:unbraind/pm-review#N` identity: **`gh:unbraind/pm-review#46`**, present on both:

- [pm-review-bun-closeout-copy](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-review/blob/8d06644a481071ed4566373660bfa0d3772c38c9/.agents/pm/issues/pm-review-bun-closeout-copy.toon)
- [pm-review-targeted-evidence-requests](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-review/blob/8d06644a481071ed4566373660bfa0d3772c38c9/.agents/pm/features/pm-review-targeted-evidence-requests.toon)

Both records are closed and retain distinct acceptance/delivery evidence. [Closure PR #55](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-review/pull/55) explicitly documents that both were delivered by [PR #46](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-review/pull/46), merge `d5f100df1bc6017d29cc670aa94dbc62eb35cb17`. A shared delivery PR is valid historical evidence, but the importer's identity tag has a different one-to-one contract.

## Expected / actual and ownership

The documented [pm-github provenance contract](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-github#readme) uses `gh:owner/repo#N` for unique import/upsert ownership and rejects duplicate tags across the existing corpus. The guard is correctly failing closed. This issue requests **affected-repository corpus repair**, not weaker idempotency checks or an importer runtime fix.

Expected: preserve both real items, their append-only histories and their shared PR #46 delivery evidence, while representing any importer identity unambiguously. Shared delivery/closing references must not accidentally declare two owners for a single import identity.

Actual: duplicate identity tags prevent even the scheduled dry-run from producing a usable import plan, so import, downstream changelog/health verification and sync publication cannot proceed.

## Acceptance / regression criteria

- Reconcile the two records' importer identity tags deliberately; preserve both item IDs, acceptance and resolution evidence, completed dates, existing history bytes, and shared delivery PR #46 links.
- Represent many-items-to-one-delivery-PR references through an appropriate non-identity relationship/link rather than duplicating a unique import key. Do not arbitrarily reassign provider ownership.
- Check the complete corpus for unique importer provenance without weakening the gate or disabling `--atomic`/`--gate`.
- On the repaired immutable revision, the dry-run above passes the provenance check and reports truthful remaining blockers, if any.
- Verify an authorized isolated or normal reviewed gated import followed by an identical repeat preserves item/history bytes and does not create duplicate items; separately record privacy, health and publication outcomes.
- Retain a regression or corpus-validation check covering two legitimate PM items delivered by one PR without declaring duplicate importer identity.

## Limits and deduplication

This is current hosted refusal plus exact static corpus evidence; no live import, tracker repair, workflow rerun or provider write was performed by this review. No data loss is claimed. All 56 all-status GitHub issue/PR records and all 59 canonical PM records were inspected. Existing [PR #33](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-review/pull/33) addressed a different missing identity for issue #30; it does not resolve the current shared #46 tags. The open ESRCH test issue #56 and pm-github's repeat-import timestamp-churn issue #175 are distinct failure classes.
